narrative.overview:
Each island is a collectible card and the page is its back. The system is built from one banded-card geometry (white face, 14px corners, a 10px band of identity colour across the top) that frames key art, stat lines, charts and tables alike. The ground is coated card stock; the shell and the cross-island strip are ink navy. Numbers are set in condensed sports numerals and carry the hierarchy by scale alone; text is a variable grotesque that narrows for labels.

Trust is the visual through-line. Every figure on the page carries a fine-print catalog number (S1 to S10) that leads to its source file, and hovering a figure lights that number in Havoc yellow and opens a navy citation tip. Yellow is rare by design: it marks the headline figure and the things a hand can act on. The density is a sports card's: tight stat cells divided by hairlines, dashed fine print at the foot, nothing ornamental.

The system refuses the KPI-tile grid where every number weighs the same; the redemption rate is stamped, the counts sit in a stat line, the context sits in panels.
keyCharacteristics: One banded-card geometry for every container, with the band colour naming its owner.
Condensed 800-weight numerals for every figure, tabular throughout.
A catalog number on every figure, chart and table, linked to its source row.
Havoc yellow reserved for the headline stamp, active and hovered interactive states, focus and selection.
One authored motion: the stamp press.

rules.name: The Headline-or-Hand Rule
rules.body: Havoc yellow appears only on the headline stamp and on interactive state (active, hover, lit, focus, selection). A static secondary figure never turns yellow.

rules.name: The One Band Per Island Rule
rules.body: HH3 is always band blue and HH2 always band violet, in the card band, name tag, chart series, legend and table chip. Rooms vs lobby is shown by the same hue at full and 35% opacity, never by a new colour.

rules.name: The Red Means Unmeasured Rule
rules.body: Not-measured red marks missing or unavailable data only; it is never decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The Numerals Wear Shoulders Rule
rules.body: Every reported figure is Big Shoulders Display 800; Archivo never sets a headline number, and Big Shoulders never sets prose.

rules.name: The Condensed Label Rule
rules.body: A label names the figure beneath it, set narrow (wdth 75), 600, tracked 0.1em, uppercase, in fine-print ink. Labels never stand above a heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The 10px Band Rule
rules.body: Every card and panel opens with a 10px band in its owner's colour: island blue or violet for island cards, ink navy for shared panels.

dos: Do frame every new section as a white banded card (14px corners, 10px top band, 1px rule border).
Do give every figure, chart and table cell a catalog number and citation tip pointing to its source file.
Do set every reported number in Big Shoulders Display 800 with tabular figures.
Do keep HH3 band blue and HH2 band violet in every place that island appears, and separate rooms from lobby with 35% opacity of the same hue.
Do use the house ease (cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)) at 0.2s for state changes and keep the stamp press the only authored animation.
Do keep hashes and file names in monospace, selectable in full.
donts: Don't use Havoc yellow on static secondary figures, deltas or decoration; it belongs to the stamp and interactive state.
Don't lay out figures as a grid of equal KPI tiles; the stamp outranks the stat line, which outranks panel detail.
Don't use not-measured red for anything except missing or unavailable data.
Don't put uppercase labels above headings as eyebrows; labels name figures only.
Don't add drop shadows to panels or introduce zero-blur offset shadows beyond the citation underline.
Don't introduce a new hue for a series or state; reuse the island hues, navy and the rules.
